<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/classify/{jobId}/upload/blocks/{index}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Send the file in blocks of at most 32 MiB with indexes 0, 1, 2, ... and then call commit. Re-sending an index replaces that block. Accepted while the job awaits its upload.
